```{python}
#| label: fig-trx-fd-dualantenna
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Block diagram of an in-band full-duplex (FD) RF front-end using two separate antennas for RX and TX, which operate simultaneously at the same frequency."
import schemdraw as sd
import schemdraw.elements as elm
import schemdraw.dsp as dsp

sd.svgconfig.svg2 = False

with sd.Drawing(canvas='svg') as d:
    d.config(unit=2, fontsize=14, margin=0.5)

    # RX path (upper antenna)
    d.push()
    elm.Antenna()
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit/2)
    dsp.Filter(response='bp').linestyle('--').label(r'$f_\mathrm{RX}$', loc='top', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Arrow().right(d.unit/2).label(r'RX')
    dsp.Amp()
    dsp.Arrow().right(d.unit/2).linestyle('--').label(r'$s_\mathrm{RX}$', 'right')
    d.pop()

    # TX path (lower antenna, same frequency as RX)
    d.move(dx=0, dy=-1*d.unit)
    elm.Antenna()
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit/2)
    dsp.Filter(response='bp').linestyle('--').label(r'$f_\mathrm{TX} = f_\mathrm{RX}$', loc='bottom', ofst=0.15)
    dsp.Line().right(d.unit/2).label(r'TX')
    dsp.Amp().reverse()
    dsp.Arrow().right(d.unit/2).reverse().linestyle('--').label(r'$s_\mathrm{TX}$', 'right')
```
